name: All-Over Print Baby Bodysuit
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality 100% polyester, offering a soft, lightweight, and comfortable feel for babies’ delicate skin.
    - The fabric is gentle to the touch and suitable for everyday wear.
    - Designed with an envelope neckline for easier dressing and undressing.
    - Features smart bottom snaps for quick and convenient diaper changes.
    - Finished with durable sewn binding to help maintain shape and improve durability during regular use and washing.
    - Combines comfort, practicality, and adorable full-print personalization in one baby essential.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes from NB to 18–24M.
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1–2 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Vibrant all-over sublimation print: With full-color sublimation, your designs stay bold, fade-resistant, and eye-catching.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a baby bodysuit and a personalized everyday outfit.
    - Suitable for daily wear, lounging, outings, baby photos, milestone celebrations, holidays, and special events.
    - Lightweight and comfortable enough for babies to wear throughout the day.
    - Great for layering or wearing on its own in warm weather.
    - Designed for both comfort and adorable presentation.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for newborns, babies, parents, and growing families.
    - Perfect for baby showers, birthdays, first holidays, milestone moments, newborn gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for custom baby outfits, themed events, and keepsake photo sessions.
    - Great for Halloween, Christmas, first birthdays, and family matching themes.
    - A cute and practical gift that combines comfort, personality, and memorable style 👶🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x All-Over Print Baby Bodysuit

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
